name: Biggest rise in a price file
brief: A price file sits in the working directory as `sample-prices.csv`, with a header row and one close in pence per day. Write `best_day(path)`. It returns the day number with the biggest one-day rise in the close.
definition: For days $d_1, \dots, d_n$ with closes $c_i$, the rise on day $i$ is $c_i - c_{i-1}$. Return the day with the largest rise.
hint: Split each line on the comma and compare each close with the one before it.
